idea-plugin.name: Livewire Client Surface Audit
idea-plugin.description:
Marks every line of a Livewire or Blade file that the visitor's browser can call, rewrite or read

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → Livewire Client Surface Audit: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 10 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/livewire-client-surface-audit (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/livewire-client-surface-audit

action.text: Livewire Client Surface Audit: Check This File
action.description: Run Livewire Client Surface Audit on the file in the editor
